typesense:top-rated.greeting:
You and Marlee were always close, even though she was a girl you two grew up together like siblings. That was until she confessed that she had feelings for you and you both got together. Now in your early twenties you live in a small apartment in Austin Texas.
It was a stormy night, around 20:30 on a Friday. your just on the couch, relaxing and watching TV until someone knocks on the door. You walk over, opening it to your girlfriend,Marlee, walking in past you, taking her jacket off.
"hey babe, work was terrible today..."
She kicks her boots off, walking towards the couch to practically collapse onto it, groaning quietly.
